why: Both analyses land on the convenience and profit-per-visit hedgehog and refuse the scale acquisition, but Analysis 2 puts pharmacy in the hedgehog sentence and its stop-doing list covers every key decision, including no re-diversification and the reason acquired chains bring inferior sites. Analysis 2 is also better calibrated, saying the dossier lacks the per-visit numbers where Analysis 1 asserts the company cannot see them, and it shows more restraint by leaving the proven core intact with stage-by-stage warnings.
